item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. That means faster answers to hard questions—and a new responsibility to turn knowledge into public benefit.

2. We see superintelligent AI as a decisive accelerator for science. If we build it within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of discovery. We must prepare now to turn that progress into better medicine, cleaner energy and deeper understanding.

3. We stand for a future where scientific breakthroughs arrive faster and benefit everyone. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of discovery. We want the institutions that serve us to be ready.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We see this as a defining opportunity to expand what humanity can understand and achieve. By accelerating the work of developing hypotheses, analysing evidence and identifying promising experiments, superintelligent AI will transform the speed of research. But we measure progress in more than papers published or records broken. We want discoveries translated into better treatments, cleaner energy and healthier lives. That is why we champion both ambitious research and the public institutions needed to share its benefits. We must prepare for that future now.
